activities.description: The capital’s biggest festival, with masked cham dancers in brocade turning in the dzong courtyard over three days.

activities.description: The wide glacial bowl where black necked cranes winter, with the crane centre, the nature trail and Gangtey Goemba.

program.name: Punakha
program.description: Days in the warm old winter capital, with the Dzong between two rivers and the suspension bridge.

program.name: Phuentsholing
program.description: Time in the border town where Bhutan begins, with the Bhutan Gate and Kharbandi above the plains.

1: Arrival at Bagdogra and transfer to Phuentsholing
Border formalities at the Bhutan Gate
Check in and the rest of the day free
2: Breakfast, then north into the hills towards Thimphu
The Chukha dam and the Wang Chhu gorge on the way
Optional: the Zorig Chusum school of arts
Arrival transfer and check in for the night
3: Breakfast, then east over the Dochula pass
The hundred and eight chortens at the top
The Memorial Chorten and the Buddha Dordenma
Tashichho Dzong and the takin preserve
Masked cham dancers in the dzong courtyard
Brocade robes, long horns and the crowd in kira
4: Breakfast in the warm Punakha valley
Wangdue Phodrang Dzong on its rocky spur
The rivers meeting below the fortress walls
The glacial bowl of the Phobjikha valley
The crane centre and the nature trail
5: Breakfast, then west down the valley to Paro
Terraced fields and farmhouses the whole way
Punakha Dzong between the Pho and Mo rivers
The long suspension bridge over the water
6: Breakfast, then out into the Paro valley
The climb up the pine slope to Taktsang
The monastery wedged into the cliff face
7: Breakfast, then the long run back south
Down through the Chukha gorge to the plains
Up to the Chele La pass at 3,988 metres
Jomolhari on the skyline on a clear morning
8: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Border formalities and transfer to Siliguri

expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: Seven nights built round the Tshechu, with Phobjikha and the Chele La pass on either side of the festival.
expert.tip: Dress respectfully for the festival ground. A collared shirt and long trousers or a full length skirt will keep everyone comfortable.

summary: 8 days through Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Punakha, Paro, with 7 nights, Breakfast and dinner each day and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the thimphu sightseeing tour, the thimphu tshechu festival, the wangdue phodrang dzong, the phobjikha valley excursion.
included: Included: 7 nights across Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Punakha, Paro with Breakfast and dinner each day; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Thimphu sightseeing tour; the Thimphu Tshechu festival; the Wangdue Phodrang Dzong; the Phobjikha valley excursion; the Punakha sightseeing tour; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; the Chele La pass; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
